author: mcuser123842ff
quote: The game is so limited in who you can kill, what you can steal, etc. Many of the early missions involve doing chores. I truly don't understand what they were going for here. All they had to do was make a crime simulator, and instead we're focused on a relationship with a girl who already left you, and you cant get out of. There are also some bugs I've come across with invisible objects or glitching through walls. Not recommended
